Flag rating limbs that extrapolate substantially beyond their gaugings

Source: R/rate_optimise.R
flag_extrapolated_limbs.Rd

Assesses support within each limb's own declared bounds (unsupported distance at an internal breakpoint) and, separately, whether the whole fitted rating's combined span fails to reach an operational range if supplied, else the complete gauged range.

Usage

flag_extrapolated_limbs(
  fit,
  tol_frac = 0.05,
  operational_lower_m = NULL,
  operational_upper_m = NULL
)

Arguments

fit

A FlodeRating instance.

tol_frac

Numeric. Fraction of a limb's stage width the unsupported gap may reach before being flagged. Default 0.05.

operational_lower_m, operational_upper_m

Numeric or NULL.

Value

A new FlodeRating instance with @limbs columns added: gauged_min_stage_m/gauged_max_stage_m, lower_unsupported_m/ upper_unsupported_m, lower_unsupported_frac/ upper_unsupported_frac, extrapolates_below_range/ extrapolates_above_range (identical on every row – a whole-fit property, not per-limb), and doubtful.

See also

rating_support() for the same unsupported extents without a tolerance applied. The support column of apply_rating() supersedes this function's single flag for deciding how far to trust a stage: it separates stages inside the gaugings from those resting on modelled evidence, on the equations alone, or on extrapolation. This function remains for marking doubtful limbs.

Examples

set.seed(42)
stage_m <- seq(0.3, 3.2, by = 0.06)
discharge_cms <- ifelse(stage_m < 1.5, 3.2 * stage_m^1.6,
                        3.2 * 1.5^1.6 * (stage_m / 1.5)^2.1) *
  exp(rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.04))

# No gaugings between 1.2 and 1.8 m, where the limbs meet
keep <- !(stage_m > 1.2 & stage_m < 1.8)
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms[keep], stage_m[keep], control = 1.5)

# Each limb stretches well beyond its nearest gauging at the junction,
# and the operational range (to 4 m) is above the highest gauging
flagged <- flag_extrapolated_limbs(fit, operational_upper_m = 4)
rating_limbs(flagged, all_columns = TRUE)[,
  c("limb", "lower_unsupported_frac", "upper_unsupported_frac",
    "extrapolates_above_range", "doubtful")]
#>     limb lower_unsupported_frac upper_unsupported_frac extrapolates_above_range
#>    <int>                  <num>                  <num>                   <lgcl>
#> 1:     1              0.0000000                   0.25                     TRUE
#> 2:     2              0.1785714                   0.00                     TRUE
#>    doubtful
#>      <lgcl>
#> 1:     TRUE
#> 2:     TRUE
